history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration further review the open fund balances under the construction fund (64CFA) related to completed projects and take appropriate action to clear the balances.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. A review of the cash balances recorded under S100 (United Nations Headquarters) was conducted, and the cash balances were found to have been converted against the wrong business area. Cash balances and open items in the fund were further reduced in 2025 and an initial return of unspent balances related to construction completed at the Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean was made. Further returns are expected after the completion of activities at the Economic Commission for Africa and the Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific, and the office blocks A–J replacement project at the United Nations Office at Nairobi.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has reviewed and corrected the misallocated 64CFA construction fund cash balances in Umoja, reduced outstanding items and returned unspent balances related to construction completed at the Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
